title: Gallery references missing terminal-overview image
reproduction: Open Gallery and inspect the console or Network panel.
expected: All gallery images return 200 and render.
actual: terminal-overview.jpg returns 404 in every sampled viewport.
recommended_fix: Map both Gallery references to the approved existing operations image or restore the intended asset, then verify all references.

title: Gallery references missing fleet-loading image
reproduction: Open Gallery and inspect Network for fleet-loading.jpg.
expected: The fleet-loading gallery item renders.
actual: The URL returns 404.
recommended_fix: Use the approved existing fleet/tanker asset or add the referenced optimized file.

title: Gallery and Lake Oil reference missing depot-terminal image
reproduction: Open Gallery or Lake Oil and inspect Network.
expected: Depot imagery and the video poster load.
actual: depot-terminal.jpg returns 404; Lake Oil has both versioned and unversioned failed references.
root_cause: performance change introduced a poster/reference without a shipped asset
recommended_fix: Restore or remap the poster and remove duplicate broken references.

title: Station imagery uses nonexistent PNG extension
reproduction: Open Station Locator and inspect the station image request.
expected: Approved station image renders.
actual: lake-energies-station-approved.png returns 404 while the repository contains the WebP variant.
recommended_fix: Update references to the existing optimized WebP and audit all duplicate extension variants.

title: Gallery references nonexistent slider image 7
reproduction: Open Gallery and inspect the n-slider/7.webp request.
expected: The slider item loads or is omitted from the approved set.
actual: n-slider/7.webp returns 404, twice in the sampled request list.
recommended_fix: Restore the approved image or remove the stale slide reference and duplicate entry.

title: Operations Projects page references missing terminal image
reproduction: Open Projects and inspect Network.
expected: Projects imagery loads.
actual: terminal-overview.jpg returns 404 in every sampled viewport.
recommended_fix: Map to an existing approved operations asset or ship the intended image.

title: Lake Oil has three missing imagery requests
reproduction: Open Lake Oil and inspect failed Network requests.
expected: Lake Oil imagery and video facade poster load.
actual: All three image URLs return 404; depot-terminal is requested again by the facade.
root_cause: wrong asset mapping / missing optimization output
recommended_fix: Repair mappings and ship only verified optimized files.

title: dotLottie WASM initialization is blocked by production CSP
reproduction: Open News, Careers, CSR, Investors, or Africa Network; inspect Console.
expected: Local dotLottie animation initializes without console errors.
actual: Primary and buffered WASM compilation violate script-src; dotlottie-web reports initialization failed.
recommended_fix: Align CSP with the supported local runtime or provide a tested non-WASM fallback; verify each page.

title: Home remains materially heavy on first visit
reproduction: Open Home with a fresh context and inspect Network/performance timing.
expected: Critical hero and navigation become usable with a compact initial request set.
actual: Sampled Home transfer was about 10.33 MB desktop and 7.56 MB mobile with about 100 resources; DCL reached about 6.4 s desktop.
root_cause: performance/resource size; page-specific assets requested too early
recommended_fix: Measure and stage Home imagery/logos further; create responsive WebP/AVIF variants and verify request priority.

title: Gallery is both heavy and erroring
reproduction: Open Gallery with a fresh context and inspect Network.
expected: Gallery loads progressively with valid assets.
actual: Sampled transfer was about 9.15–9.93 MB, DCL about 5.9–7.0 s, and six failed 404 image requests per viewport.
root_cause: performance/resource size plus stale asset references
recommended_fix: Repair URLs, stage gallery images, and serve responsive optimized variants.

title: Active service worker can preserve legacy site state
reproduction: Open the site, wait for registration, then inspect navigator.serviceWorker and Cache Storage.
expected: Delivery state is deterministic and the cache policy is intentionally controlled.
actual: A root-scoped service worker installs sw.js?v=73-20260828-01 and creates lake-precache-v73-20260828-01; pwa.js registers it sitewide.
recommended_fix: Document and test one explicit lifecycle, or remove the PWA layer if not required; verify update and rollback behavior.

title: Service worker precache contains known missing asset URLs
reproduction: Inspect PRECACHE_URLS and compare each entry with the repository/public URLs.
expected: Precache manifest contains only valid files.
actual: Known 404 image references are included in the precache list; install skips them best-effort.
recommended_fix: Generate precache entries from verified build output and fail CI on missing files.

title: Old Subsidiaries terminology remains in visible network/country UI
reproduction: Open Africa Network and inspect the visible statistics/country labels.
expected: Public category/navigation terminology consistently uses Business Verticals where applicable.
actual: Visible text includes counts such as “10 subsidiaries” and “5 subsidiaries”.
recommended_fix: Classify each phrase; update category labels while preserving source-backed legal/factual wording.

title: Contact page visibly uses subsidiaries wording in public copy
reproduction: Open Contact and inspect the reach-our-team paragraph.
expected: UI/category wording matches the current Business Verticals terminology policy.
actual: Copy says Lake Group and its subsidiaries.
recommended_fix: Review against approved factual wording; change only if it is UI/category language.

title: Africa Network and related pages load a broken dotLottie path at runtime
reproduction: Open Africa Network and inspect the animation console/request.
expected: The animation either initializes or a graceful static fallback appears without errors.
actual: web-designs.lottie request is aborted in sampled runs while WASM initialization also fails.
recommended_fix: Make the fallback explicit and ensure only the intended page-specific animation is initialized.

title: Direct YouTube embeds remain on heavy public pages
reproduction: Open the named pages and inspect iframe/src before clicking play.
expected: Heavy video resources load after explicit user intent where the facade contract applies.
actual: Africa Network has a direct YouTube iframe; related pages contain direct embeds requiring separate review.
recommended_fix: Audit each embed and standardize a poster facade where approved.

title: Placeholder logo path is missing on three company pages
reproduction: Serve the repository locally and open any named page; inspect Network.
expected: All company logo references resolve or use a deliberate fallback.
actual: The placeholder logo request returns 404.
recommended_fix: Use a shipped fallback or remove the dead references.

title: Lake Agro legacy pages reference missing framework stylesheets
reproduction: Serve the repository locally and open la-home.html or la-projects.html.
expected: Legacy direct-access pages load their declared stylesheets or are redirected safely.
actual: Both stylesheet URLs return 404 and the pages show many failed requests/overflow in the local crawl.
recommended_fix: Decide whether the legacy URLs remain public; if yes, repair dependencies, otherwise add a deliberate redirect.

title: Source initializes reveal logic more than once
reproduction: Inspect assets/site.js and trace DOMContentLoaded reveal initialization.
expected: Each global reveal observer/listener is initialized once.
actual: initReveal() is invoked twice in the shared startup path, risking duplicate observers/handlers.
recommended_fix: Make initialization idempotent and add a regression test for listener/observer counts.

title: PWA registration waits for window load and schedules recurring updates
reproduction: Inspect pwa.js and observe registration/update timer behavior.
expected: Noncritical PWA work cannot compete with page rendering or create surprise state transitions.
actual: Registration is attached to window load and an interval performs update checks sitewide.
recommended_fix: Make lifecycle explicit, defer noncritical checks, and test update behavior with cached old/new builds.

title: Local 404 route shows a transformed element outside the viewport bounds
reproduction: Open local 404.html at 390px and inspect the audit broken-rect report.
expected: No visible content extends beyond the viewport or creates a possible narrow-width overflow.
actual: The local audit found a visible rect extending to x≈409px at a 390px viewport, although document scrollWidth remained 390px.
recommended_fix: Inspect the reported element and constrain its width/transform at small widths.

title: Lake Steel logo request is aborted during mobile navigation
reproduction: Open Lake Steel mobile in a fresh context and inspect the logo request.
expected: The page logo completes or is intentionally cancelled without visible brand loss.
actual: The crawler observed ERR_ABORTED for LAKE_LOGO_LAKE_ONLY.png on mobile; impact needs visual confirmation.
recommended_fix: Reproduce with Network preservation and verify whether the aborted request leaves a broken logo.

title: Several production HTML pages expose repeated Lottie initialization errors
reproduction: Open each page and inspect the Console.
expected: No uncaught runtime errors on normal public pages.
actual: Each affected page logs primary WASM, buffered fallback, and initialization failure messages.
recommended_fix: Fix once in the canonical loader/CSP path and add cross-page console-error coverage.

title: Cross-engine coverage is unavailable in the current environment
reproduction: Attempt to launch installed browser engines.
expected: Required browser matrix is exercised before release.
actual: Only Chromium was available; Firefox and WebKit were unavailable, so Safari/Edge-native findings are unverified.
recommended_fix: Run the same suite in CI or a machine with Firefox/WebKit/Edge and physical mobile coverage.
